name: Kirkland Signature Organic Unsweetened Applesauce Pouches
whyItWorks: Cooked and finely pureed peeled apples provide soothing soluble pectin without harsh insoluble skin flakes. Soluble pectin forms a protective gel that helps firm up loose bowel movements during flare recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ready to eat directly from the squeeze pouch at room temperature or chilled. A perfect portable emergency flare snack.
